thread:
ria: FYI — incoming support ticket 23218. User signed up via web, completed email verification, then got redirected (region switch) during payment. They say onboarding credits never appeared (expected +25). Payment method: Apple Pay virtual card; user reports 3DS success.

dave-payments: can you paste the account id or a safe identifier? I need to pull PSP logs.

ria: safe id: acct_7f9b. Created 2026-03-15T12:04Z. Email-verify webhook received 2026-03-15T12:05Z. Payment token created 12:06. PSP 3DS callback at 12:08 shows auth success, but the grants pipeline shows `PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW`. Logs:

```
2026-03-15T12:05:03Z INFO email-webhook user=acct_7f9b event=email_verified
2026-03-15T12:06:18Z INFO payments token_created token=pm_tok_83
2026-03-15T12:08:07Z INFO psps-callback pm_auth success pm_id=pm_abc123 country=US
2026-03-15T12:09:01Z WARN grants-service gate=region_mismatch signup_country=FR payment_country=US -> requires_manual_review=true
```

jenna-support: sounds like the autogrant flow blocked because signup_ip resolved to FR while payment country was US. That's a common manual-review gate. Did the customer get any UI notice about review?

ria: Customer saw "credits pending review" only. Said they passed all verifications. No anti-fraud flags on the PSP side.

mateo-engineering: Thanks — looks like a race between the email-verify/autogrant trigger and the payment country field getting populated from the PSP callback. Our current rule evaluates grants once the email-verify event fires; if `payment_country` is missing we default to treating it as mismatch to be safe. That default causes manual queue entries. We should change that default, but short term we can manual-grant.

ria: Can someone do a manual grant and note the reason so we can close ticket? Steps for quick manual grant:
1) Admin console -> Billing -> Grants -> +Grant -> account: acct_7f9b amount: 25 reason: "autogrant-failed-region-race"
OR via internal API: `POST /admin/grants` body: `{"account_id":"acct_7f9b","amount":25,"reason":"autogrant-failed-region-race"}`

dave-payments: I checked the payments audit: pm_country=US, processor notes show 3DS passed. No fraud flags. I'm granting now.

grant-bot: credits_granted: +25 to acct_7f9b by dave-payments at 2026-03-15T12:22:50Z :white_check_mark:

ria: I'll update the ticket: "Credits issued manually while we fix race condition. We apologize for the delay." Closing after customer confirms.

mateo-engineering: Created ENG-6124 to: (1) make grants evaluation wait for a short window for payment callbacks before defaulting to manual gate, (2) add idempotent late-grant path when PSP confirms 3DS and email verified, (3) add a smoke test for virtual cards + region switch flows. ETA next sprint.

jenna-support: great — thanks everyone. I'll leave a note for CS to check similar tickets created in the same 20m window.

ria: thumbs up. Follow-up: if we see >5 hits/day we should temporary relax autogrant gate for verified emails with 3DS success.

mateo-engineering: noted. I'll add a monitoring alert for manual-grant rate on the autogrant flow.
